_comment: Submission: E7 (configs/b2_ens_dr.json) with P(alive) replaced by the stoppage classifier g of scripts/alive_dev.py, trained on all development matches (SkillCorner rows with at least 14 detected players; DFL with the dead ball hidden, with the simulator's ball gaps and with the same gaps at positions independent of the game). P(home|alive), team swap, ball-out rule and rounding are E7's. Adopted by the rule of scripts/alive_select2.py, fixed before the classifier was trained (experiments/alive_select2.md); decoder costs (2, 12) by the zone score on all folds. Nothing tuned on BAR-ATH.
